# Marcuse

*1898 – 1979 · German-American · [Frankfurt School](../movements/frankfurt-school.md)*

German philosopher who emigrated to the United States, a member of the [Frankfurt School](../movements/frankfurt-school.md): Eros and Civilization combines Marx and Freud, and One-Dimensional Man made him a reference for the 1968 protest movements.
